checks: Expanded widget defaults to manual lookup; typing and opening never query or save
Invalid input is rejected without creating history
Enter queries offline; edited meaning saves once, as a manual record, only on explicit favorite
Known word forms show existing records and append new meanings without replacing the preferred meaning
Saved words are searchable in the favorites tab; switching tabs preserves the lookup draft
Dictionary misses allow manual meaning and favorite, with an empty-meaning guard
Unconfigured Microsoft lookup guides to settings while keeping the local meaning and favorite status
Favorite status arrives during online lookup; delayed responses cannot replace a newly entered word
Explicit Microsoft lookup renders the translation, reuses cache, and never overwrites favorites
Favorites survive closing and page reload; the host page cannot read the panel and Escape still closes it
